source-test-file-paths.test-command: dotnet test ./src/Tests/Nop.Tests/Nop.Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~TaxServiceTests" --collect:'XPlat Code Coverage' --results-directory ./TestResults --verbosity minimal && find ./TestResults -name 'coverage.cobertura.xml' -exec cp {} ./TestResults/coverage.cobertura.xml \; && echo 'Tests completed with coverage'
